Article 8.1: BOGO (Buy One Get One Free Accounts)

Warren's summary

When a BOGO promotion is active, every purchased Standard MAX or FFN Perps evaluation earns one free evaluation of the same type and size, though STEADY purchases do not earn a free account. You must activate your free account from your dashboard within 45 calendar days of purchase, and you can only have one free account active and tradeable at any time. You must hold at least one active paid account or an active tradeable Sim Funded account to activate and keep a free account; if only a free account remains active, it will be cancelled within 3 days. The free account must be the same type and size as the purchased account, and a blown free account is not reset for free.

What Is the BOGO Offer?

When a BOGO promotion is active, every purchased Standard MAX evaluation earns one free evaluation of the same type and size. Every purchased FFN Perps evaluation comes with its free account at purchase: you get two accounts, the one you buy and a free one of the same size. STEADY purchases do not earn a free account. Free accounts already earned stay redeemable under the rules in Article 8.3.

How to Claim Your Free Account
Purchase a Standard MAX or FFN Perps evaluation during the BOGO promotion period.
FFN Perps: there is nothing to claim. Your free account opens with your purchase.
Your free account is added to your FFN dashboard automatically, in the same account type and size you purchased.
Activate it from your dashboard within 45 calendar days of your purchase (Article 8.3).
BOGO Rules and Restrictions
Every purchased Standard MAX or FFN Perps evaluation earns ONE free account. STEADY purchases do not earn a free account.
Only ONE free account may be active and tradeable at any time. A free FFN Perps account does not count toward this limit.
To activate a new free account, the previous free account must be cancelled or resolved first.
You MUST hold at least one active paid account (or an active, tradeable Sim Funded account) to activate and keep a free account (Article 8.3). If only a free account remains active, it will be cancelled within 3 days.
If you FAIL the free account, cancel it from the dashboard. Then activate your next free account from your dashboard.
If you PASS the free account, it moves to its next stage like any other passed evaluation, and you can activate your next free account from your dashboard.
A blown free account is NOT reset for free.
BOGO REQUIREMENT: A QUALIFYING ACCOUNT MUST REMAIN ACTIVE A free (BOGO) account cannot exist without an active paid account (or an active, tradeable Sim Funded account) beside it. If no qualifying account remains, the free account will be cancelled within 3 days. You cannot keep only a free account.

Q: Can I get a BOGO account of a different size than what I purchased?

A: No. The free BOGO account must be the same type and size as the purchased account.

Q: What happens if I have multiple BOGO accounts queued?

A: You can only activate one free account at a time. Your other free accounts wait in your dashboard. Activate the next one once your previous free account is resolved, within its own 45-day redemption period.
